text: {character:Miki Nikaidou}Hehe... They were already pretty confused, and then you pop up out of nowhere. It would be weird if they didn't react that way.
{character:Wanjirou}Don't worry, I don't really mind, woof.
Wanjirou
Miki Nikaidou
Yumeko Jabami
{character:Wanjirou}Nyaa?
{character:Wanjirou}Eh... You are a cat person, then. So dogs haven't become that popular...
{character:Wanjirou}Woof? What did you just say, Miki?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Nothing, never mind.
{character:Wanjirou}By the way, why are you here with me to welcome guests? What happened to her, woof?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Ichihime's fine, she just ate too much spicy food, so she has a stomachache, hehe... She just needs some rest.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}What? Mr. Wanjirou?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}A high school girl who's that adaptable is kinda scary...
{character:Wanjirou}I knew it! I know why your uniform looks familiar to me, woof. Miki, do you remember the high school student who came earlier?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Now that you mention it, although their uniforms are a little different, they do look like they're from the same school.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Oh, somebody got here before us?
{character:Wanjirou}Woof, she should still be in the reception room. Maybe you know each other.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Maybe it’s fate. Who might it be?
{character:Wanjirou}Please come in.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Wow, there really is a mahjong table in here. So we can gamble now? Alright, didn't you just mention there's another person? Wanna play mahjong together?
{character:Wanjirou}Compared to her schoolmate, she cares more about mahjong, woof...
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Ah, sorry, I almost forgot. Who was the one who arrived earlier—
{character:Midari Ikishima}Yo! Yumeko!
{character:Yumeko Jabami}... Oh, it's you.
{character:Wanjirou}Woof?! You could cut the tension with a knife! Is it normal for high school girls to look at each other like that?!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}It seems there is a story behind it that we don't know about.
Midari Ikishima
{character:Midari Ikishima}Hehe, hehehe... The wait was totally worth it.
{character:Midari Ikishima}To be meeting you, even in this weird place. Must be destiny!
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Yeah, some terrible misfortune.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Fortune or misfortune! That doesn't matter!
{character:Wanjirou}Woof?! Are high school girls supposed to say things... like that?! Woof?!
{character:Yumeko Jabami}I refuse.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Huh?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Dream all you want, but I've never said I'm down.
{character:Midari Ikishima}You... You must be joking, Yumeko.
{character:Midari Ikishima}You've revved the engine, and now you wanna hit the brakes?! Come on, you can't be like that!
{character:Yumeko Jabami}…
{character:Midari Ikishima}... P—please, don't give me that look...
{character:Midari Ikishima}If you don't want to play with me, then what should I do with my... I can't get it out of my system...
{character:Yumeko Jabami}That's none of my business.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Ah... T—This is just too much... Yumeko? Where are you going?!
{character:Yumeko Jabami}That's none of your business...
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Wait a second.
{character:Wanjirou}Right, right, woof. We're all friends. Why make it awkward? Let's do what she suggested: sit down, play mahjong, and chill. Wouldn't that be nice?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}I refuse. I'll play with anyone except her.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Don't—don't say that... Yumeko, Yumeko!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Is there a reason you hate playing with her so much?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Because she broke the rules so many times in the first place.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}I see. So it's Midari's fault, hehe...
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Eh? What do you mean?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Let me guess, you must love gambling, right?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Yep, of course. Gambling is my jam!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Right. It's strange, then. You refuse to do your favorite thing just because you don't like Ikishima.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Ah, well...
{character:Miki Nikaidou}It may sound like a sophistry, but putting that aside, mahjong is a four-player game.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}No, I didn't mean it... Ok, I got it.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Just this time, then. Mr. Wanjirou, Miss Nikaidou.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Hehe, that's my girl. Don't think too much, just have fun.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Oh oh oh?! Yumeko, you are staying?!
{character:Wanjirou}That's Nikaidou for you. So good at persuading, woof.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Midari, come join us, too.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Don't worry, Yumeko. I just played with Midari, so I know a thing or two about her now.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}She is indeed a slightly dangerous kid, but she cares about winning. She'll behave herself. Right, Midari?
{character:Midari Ikishima}Of—of course. Yumeko, come... Come play with us.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}... If Miss Nikaidou says so.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Good... Good! Miki! It's so kind of you!
{character:Yumeko Jabami}A little bit.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}What's special with the rules, Miss Nikaidou?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}I'm interested just imagining it! Let's go! I want to play it!
{character:Wanjirou}Woof woof woof?!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Hehe... Wonderful. Your new rules are quite popular.
{character:Wanjirou}Why do I feel a little frustrated…?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}I want to play, too. But I'm worried about Ichihime. I'll go check up on her first. Please give me a few minutes.
{character:Wanjirou}Nikaidou, why did you insist Yumeko join the game, woof?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}To lighten up the mood, I suppose?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}You are surprisingly sharp today... Wanjirou, why do you think they came to this shrine?
{character:Wanjirou}How am I supposed to know, woof?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}At the moment, I don't know what their wishes are. So, according to the tradition in the shrine, we can only treat them with mahjong first.
{character:Wanjirou}You've got a point. Well, doing something is better than doing nothing, woof.
{character:Wanjirou}Madness?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}That kid is… Well, she's clearly a gambling maniac.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}What will the games be like? I can't wait, hehe...
{character:Wanjirou}(Ikishima is completely ignored... But she doesn't seem to mind at all. And she even looks somewhat infatuated?)
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Sorry, I'm sure Mary didn't mean to be rude. She just panicked.
{character:Wanjirou}Woof! Rude. High school girls scare too easy these days.
{character:Wanjirou}A god needs respect, not fear! Besides, I'm not scary at all. Seriously, I'm cute, am I not?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Nice to meet you, too, woof! Ah, I guess I should have said 'nyaa.'
{character:Wanjirou}A silly cat, for sure... Ah, yes, Yumeko.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Excuse me! Ah, is that a mahjong table?
Wanjirou and Miki don't know how to react after seeing how excited Yumeko got when she noticed the mahjong table.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}It'd be more accurate to say she cares more about 'gambling', hehe...
{character:Midari Ikishima}I suddenly appeared in this garbage shrine. Although I didn't know what was going on, I had a hunch that I'd see you here!
{character:Midari Ikishima}Hehe, come and turn me on, Yumeko. I've been imagining what will go down between us. I almost... Can't hold it anymore—
{character:Midari Ikishima}See that mahjong table over there? With that, there is only one thing left for us to do... Let's get down to it, Yumeko!
{character:Wanjirou}Woof... Why did things turn out this way, woof…?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Does that mean you care more about holding a grudge than you do about the gambling you say you love?
Yumeko intended to leave the reception room to keep herself from getting "jinxed," but Nikaidou's words stopped her.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}You are welcome! Yumeko, have you ever played mahjong?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}The Yaku and Han are the same as Riichi Mahjong, but the process is a little different. Yumeko, have you heard of 'Bloody Mahjong'?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}It rings a bell. Its name comes from the local rules called "Battle to the Bloody End" in Sichuan, China. Am I right?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}This time's special rules will introduce some features based on 'Battle to the Bloody End' to Riichi Mahjong when a player wins.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Oh? Could it be?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}I'm guessing you've already figured it out. Yes, the game keeps going even after someone wins.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}In other words, when there are winners, the other players have more chances to draw. I'd even call it the perfect opportunity to optimize their hand.
{character:Wanjirou}Hehe, terrifying, right? I designed it, myself—
{character:Wanjirou}I'll go check on that silly cat, too, woof.
{character:Wanjirou}I've known you for a long time, woof! You definitely had some other reasons for doing it, woof.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}You don't sound like a shrine staff member. They came here because they have wishes.
{character:Wanjirou}And it's weird to ask a little girl to apologize. Yumeko, right? Nice to meet a kind girl like you, woof!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Don't let them surprise you so easily. These are no ordinary high school girls, Wanjirou.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}But you aren't any better, are you, Yumeko?
{character:Midari Ikishima}The rules here are slightly different from what you've played, Yumeko.

{character:Miki Nikaidou}Leaving Wanjirou and me behind just because you want to shun someone makes us a little upset. And, your leaving keeps us from being able to start the game. Is that how you want to treat your beloved gambling?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}You're a knowledgeable gambler, indeed. Since you've heard of it, it'll be easier for me to explain.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}In that case, the first winner might just run into the biggest trouble... Ah... Just thinking about it makes me...
{character:Yumeko Jabami}After all, I'm the 'loser-cat'. Nyaa! Nyaa!
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Okay, come back soon!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Right? Besides, I'm looking forward to seeing the 'madness' in that Yumeko kid
